messages.subject: occu and occuRN in the same model selection
parts:
Hi all,

So I heard two opposite explanation on this. One said that we could not compare model fitted with occu and occuRN in the same model selection because they have different model probability structure and estimate different parameter. And the other said that they could, cause essentially the response variable is the same. Any thought? this makes me confuse, I am using both and compare them just from the rsq. Thanks!

Best,
Wulan

messages.author: 4a15de51da4445ae
messages.subject: Re: [unmarked] occu and occuRN in the same model selection
parts:
hi Wulan,
 
 You cannot compare them as implemented in unmarked because the form of the likelihood is different

 However a certain restriction on the RN model produces exactly the standard occupancy model and the likelihoods can then be compared directly. This is discussed on page 136 of Royle and Dorazio (2008) and shown in panel 4.2 .
 
 But this is not implemented in unmarked.

 There are probably other ways to do it but you have to be very careful.

regards
andy
